lines.2: 「I-I mean, I definitely saw you, but...」
lines.5: 「--Did you think that would make me blush?」
lines.7: Right. She was the type who smiled when she was angry.
lines.11: Otome drove a powerful straight punch into my stomach and left me unable to stand.
lines.12: So I apologized in seiza--or rather, crouched over in pain.
lines.13: 「I suppose I got too familiar, or didn't show enough consideration...」
lines.14: 「But I really did knock, you know?」
lines.16: 「Knocking is pointless if you come in while you're doing it, you idiot!」
lines.17: Otome unleashed the words in one furious rush.
